question: What procedures will be explained in the twenty-first chapter?
premises: The twenty-first chapter includes the rite concerning the dead and the living and the net.
It includes lordship over positions and a group of consecratory rites.
It also includes an examination of strength and weakness.
inference: Therefore, the twenty-first chapter will set forth these ritual procedures and assessments.
uncertainties: The technical meanings of jāla and padeśa may be specified more precisely in the twenty-first chapter.
plain_english: In the twenty-first chapter, the procedures to be explained are the rite of the dead and the living, the net, lordship over positions, the group of consecratory rites, and the examination of strength and weakness.
